exp1.Collected_date: 2025 (ethics protocol dated 2025-01-24; exact collection dates not reported)

Physical_Environment.Location: Online (Pavlovia); participants: psychology students at the University of Padova, Italy

Equipment.Software: PsychoPy 2022.2.4 (Peirce et al., 2019), administered via Pavlovia

Experimental_Design.Conditions: 2 (label identity: TU = self, SCONOSCIUTO = stranger) x 2 (trial type: matching, nonmatching) within-subjects; longitudinal: same matching task at session 2 (T2) and session 3 (T3), about one week apart; 200 formal trials per session = 4 conditions x 50

Block_Structure.Trial_number: 200 trials per session (50 per condition; 100 matching + 100 nonmatching; 20 practice trials not included in the exported data)

Trial_Structure.Stimulus_order: simultaneous (shape above, label below the vertical centre)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: square or triangle (0.3 x 0.3 height units; shape-identity association counterbalanced across participants: condizione 1 = square-self, condizione 2 = triangle-self; assignment learned at session 2 and maintained at session 3)
Stimulus_Properties.Label: TU (self) / SCONOSCIUTO (stranger), presented in Italian (Arial, letter height 0.06 height units)

exp1.detail: SPE-self-esteem longitudinal study (OSF tmk5b; author analysis script SPE_SE_analyses_rv.R in the input zone). 200 undergraduate psychology students from the University of Padova (Italy) were invited; 149 volunteered for session 1, 119 took part in session 2, 97 in session 3; the matching task data files contain 116 (T2) and 93 (T3) participants (3 and 4 participants' data respectively absent from the archive). Ethics: Ethics Committee for Psychological Research of the University of Padova (Protocol 987-a, dated 2025-01-24); study conducted entirely online via Pavlovia. This database row covers the shape-label matching task only (S2 and S3; S1 had no matching task - IAT + NLT + RSES only). Data: author aggregate exports matching_task_2.csv / matching_task_3.csv (no per-participant raw files); columns: participant / condizione (1, 2) / type_trial (exp) / label (TU, SCONOSCIUTO) / shape (images/square.png, images/triangle.png) / matching_task.corr (1/0; 0 with NA rt = missed trial in the author's coding) / matching_task.rt (seconds) / shape_type / who (self/other = label identity, redundant) / trial_type (match_self, match_other, nonmatch_self, nonmatch_other = actual stimulus combination; match iff (label==TU)==(shape==self-shape per condizione), verified 100% consistent). Library products: raw + Clean merge sessions 2 and 3 with a Session column (2/3); 42,918 rows; 140 unique subjects (116 at session 2, 93 at session 3, 69 overlap; 3 participant IDs contain leading/trailing whitespace - trimmed in Subject, raw keeps the original column). The author's counterbalance variable 'condizione' is kept under the English column name Condition in Clean (raw keeps the original name). No-response trials (rt NA, author codes 0) are coded ACC=NA, RT_ms=NA per library convention (author miss coding documented). Duplicated/extra sessions kept as-is (minimal preprocessing): 3 T2 participants with 400 rows (two runs; author excluded LFVI/GSMA/JRHA from analyses) and 4 T3 participants with >200 rows (author dropped CTNA/FPMA/ESAD/mtma) plus 2 partial T3 participants (150/137 rows); the author's analysis also kept only correct matching trials, removed +/-3 SD outliers per participant x condition, and dropped participants with <50 valid matching trials (analysis N: 106 at T2, 84 at T3). numTrials = 200 per session (textual, sessions with duplicated/extra runs noted).
